full_judgment:
60. What is more important the defendant petitioners had an alternative forum for the purpose of filing an application under section 19(2) of the Ain for setting aside the ex-parte order and decree. The petitioners have another remedy in the form of preferring an appeal under section 41 of the Ain, 2003 of course subject to limitation. But they have not yet availed themselves of any of those remedies. Section 41 runs as follows: 

 62. The petitioners have resorted to a wrong forum by invoking the writ jurisdiction of this Court. They can still avail the remedy at least under section 41, of course subject to the limitation issue.
